title: RevoGrocers: Sales Performance Analysis
summary: SQL-based analysis of category performance and customer repeat-purchase behaviour to support revenue growth.
problem: RevoGrocers needed to identify underperforming categories and opportunities to achieve a 10% revenue growth target.
goal: Recommend data-driven actions aligned with revenue growth
keyFindings: Confection, Meat, and Poultry generated 34.5% of total revenue
Seafood, Grain, and Shellfish contributed only 22.0% combined
Grain recorded the highest average price but the lowest repeat purchase rate
recommendations: Introduce targeted cross-selling for Seafood and Shellfish
Determine free shipping thresholds based on order value distribution
